name: Omamagoto ~Hahaoya Shoujo to Chiyahoya Shippori~
original_name: おままごと　～母親少女とちやほやしっぽり～
source: Social reforms have changed the lives of people. To combat the increase in NEETs the government has lowered the age for marriage and given people a universal basic income. Kei-kun's father recently married Maaya an underage schoolgirl. However his father died just after the wedding leaving him to take care of her himself. Thus starts his sweet sexual life with Maaya, a sexually inexperienced schoolgirl who's supposed to be his new mother.
translation: 社会改革改变了人们的生活。为了应对尼特族人数的增加，政府降低了结婚年龄，并为人们提供了普遍的基本收入。Kei-kun的父亲最近与一名未成年女学生Maaya结婚。然而，他的父亲在婚礼后不久就去世了，留下他独自照顾她。就这样，他与玛雅开始了甜蜜的性生活，玛雅是一个没有性经验的女学生，她应该是他的新母亲。
